content:
@everyone
I know there are some of us who aren't available for the final fight on Friday, so here's a chance to tell us the epilogue that your character would try and experience should we defeat the hunger on Friday. Feel free to tell the future of your story and/or mix it in with the ooc commentary on moments you loved while playing

No idea what context this stuff will take on given *things* but in Leaf's tree is currently her "goodbye"/will. It was mostly something I made so that I as a player could be prepared for that to happen. It's only been 5 weeks but I feel like I've played this character for years. Anyway, it was just a Google doc for a while but I wasn't happy with the format so I dug up the ol not-photoshop skills are started making an actual version of what it looks like. I'm not quite done with it but here's a sneak peek.

*Inside a small box you find several carefully folded pieces of paper surrounded by handfuls of blooming flowers.

The paper closest to the top is folded separately, and written with slightly different paper and ink. The handwriting is unmistakably Leaf's cursive, somehow making the Goblin language look elegant.*

(I have this one ready but I'll post it later for extra feels)

*Next is a set of several papers all folded together, though you can tell by the creases that she referred to these documents often. Some are worn thin from being in her pocket. A few show signs of water damage and smudging. 

The first page is a journal entry, this time written in Common:*

The other pages are songs from the playlist I have for her. Things she'd want people to remember if she wasn't there to tell them herself. I'll probably post the whole thing on Friday if *ya know* no one needs to see it before then 😅

Lucky has taken a liking to most of the colonists he's made friends witb and while he understands that several of them have weaknesses and traits that make it difficult to work with them at times, their hearts are true. They're simply doing what they understands to do, he wants to teach them and learn from them in kind. So he would actually be interested in making his own voyage across the sea to the old world to learn of the many traditions and ways of life that they have which led these colonists to become what they are and hopes that maybe he can understand what let them to become what they are, of their traditions, as well as being as powerful and driven as they are.  he finds them inspiring he finds them happy at times and while several of them have had their own struggles he believes. he honestly believes in all of them, he believes that they should be happy too.

|| but he could never have that, in his age he is beheld to watch over his people, and in a weeks time from the great battle, the spirits of his ancestors call to him. He says his goodbyes to his friends in the colony, and his beloved people. He leaves lucky's magic hut open with a raven and a dream catcher at the door. Sometimes the colony will find pouches of tobacco at their doorstep||

||in the wake of croatoans defeat, kiln will find her two coffees already waiting for her, leaf will find a bottle of perfume at her bedside, cato will find a sickle, and wynne will find a vest with several organic components for spells. And if anyone prays to chauntea, you might be met by a gentle firbolg with a fresh harvest.||

Adrian Conway: Gentleman, Scholar, and friend to all. 

Adrian finally opens up his free clinic under Which Witchery. It is called Undying Light Free Clinic. While running the clinic he continues his research on the Uru, Jackalopes, and Chinokin so that he can be able to help in every medical way. 
He goes on to designing a healthcare system for the people of Roanoke. It first starts out as a volunteer business and later explodes. He opens up the first hospital of the island and names it Sandigill Medical Center; its purpose is not only to treat the people of Roanoke but to treat all people of the island. This was Adrians dream all along, to help, heal, and leave a lasting impression on all.
